notes: The candidate uses an adapter-supplied derived object class inheriting one directed interaction and directly declaring a second, with a distinct base object class publishing the inherited interaction. It removes only the inherited interaction from the derived class using the set-based unpublish service, then requests the subject's state through standard HLArequestPublications. The follow-up MIM reports must retain the ordinary object and interaction publications, the remaining derived-class directed interaction, and the distinct base object-class publication; each directed report gives HLAnumberOfClasses as two. This does not cover DDM regions or claim provider-independent conformance.

requirements.statement: The subject publishes the inherited interaction and the class-specific interaction under the adapter-selected derived object class, and publishes the inherited interaction under its distinct base class, through the standard set-based publication service.

The subject supplies a set containing the inherited interaction published under the derived object class; the subsequent query checks that the unlisted class-specific interaction and the independent base object-class publication remain.

After partial unpublication, the standard MIM publication query reports the remaining derived-class interaction and the base object-class/interaction pair, with HLAnumberOfClasses equal to two; ordinary object-class and interaction publication reports remain unchanged.
